info.title: FitFlex Organizer API
info.description: For organizers' timing, registration and kit-desk systems. Authentication: exchange a client id and secret at POST /v1/organizer/token for a 15-minute bearer token. Scopes, event restrictions, revocation and expiry are checked on every call. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC, JSON is camelCase, lists use opaque cursors. Organizers never receive participant phone or email through this API. See organizer-api-guide.md and organizer-webhooks.md.

post.summary: Exchange client credentials for a bearer token
post.description: The only route that accepts the client secret. Every failed exchange is the same 401 invalid_client.

scopes.registrations:read: Read registrations (names, category, status, bib, kit).
scopes.registrations:demographics: Also gender and age on event day.
scopes.webhooks:manage: Manage webhooks (granted by the organizer owner only).
scopes.results:read: Read results and release history (needs registrations:read).
scopes.results:write: Submit PROVISIONAL results. It cannot verify, release, correct or disqualify them (needs registrations:read).

error.description: A stable machine code, e.g. invalid_client, insufficient_scope, event_not_found.

Error.description: Every error is { error, ...extra } (D5). 5xx bodies carry requestId.

Registration.description: gender and ageOnEventDay exist only with the registrations:demographics scope. There is NO phone, email, date of birth, emergency contact, payer or payment field.

id.description: The outbox id. Consumers dedupe on it; cursors may overlap.

payload.description: The QR text (FFEV1:…) for method scan.

ResultItem.description: No names and no contact data. Ranks are set by FitFlex on official release. Use revision to order updates.

id.description: The outbox id: stable across endpoints and retries — your dedupe key.

WebhookEnvelope.description: No names, phones, emails, amounts or tokens. Fetch authorised fields with GET /v1/organizer/registrations/{id}.

url.description: https, port 443, a DNS name that resolves only to public addresses.
